scene: Everyday residential care at the resident’s own pace. An 88-year-old East Asian man with a bald crown, sparse white hair and visibly advanced facial ageing sits independently on a simple chair, slowly fastening the buttons of his own cardigan with his two hands. A Black male care worker aged 42 in a plain muted blue care tunic sits nearby at respectful distance with both hands resting on a folded towel on his lap. The worker watches patiently, giving the man time to do it himself. A small complete clipboard lies on an adjacent low stool, suggesting scheduled tasks waiting. Exactly two people, two arms and two hands each. No physical contact or touching the man’s clothes, no restraint, no album, brochure, dialogue text, logos or medical equipment. The older person acts; the worker waits attentively. Clear 80+ age cues without caricature. All meaningful objects inset from all four image boundaries. Let outer chair legs and peripheral marks taper into irregular broken pencil strokes with paper gaps, never a straight image-boundary crop or rectangular backdrop.
